name: Animated Sidebar
summary: Composable React app sidebar that morphs into an icon rail on desktop and becomes a focus-managed sheet on mobile.
description: A copy-paste React application sidebar with morphing nested navigation that collapses into an animated icon rail on desktop and becomes a focus-managed sheet on mobile. Installed through the beUI shadcn registry or copied manually; the page includes the props/API reference, theme token notes and the shared utility files.
contains: shadcn CLI install: bunx --bun shadcn add @beui/animated-sidebar
collapses into an animated icon rail on desktop; collapsible modes none, icon, offcanvas
API reference: provider, menu, group, rail, inset and footer subcomponents
beUI registry has 124 items; Pro tier adds 292+ blocks ($149 lifetime)
